verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only local model download and execution (Hugging Face search/download, local serving, and the llmster headless daemon for self-run servers and cloud instances). Nothing documents a hosted cloud tier that runs models without downloading them. The Bionic line about running frontier open models for demanding tasks never says those models are hosted remotely or skip the local download, so it cannot be credited as cloud offload.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient
